Meet the Nov 2 Deadline Risk-Free: ezAccounting Software Automates Q3 IRS Form 941 E-Filing and Core Business Operations
 PR Newswire Wed, October 28, 2026 at 5:00 AM EDT 3 min read Streamline your Q3 tax deadline on Monday, November 2, 2026, while managing invoices, purchase orders, and payroll inside the secure, offline ezAccounting platform. 
 REDMOND, Wash., Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Halfpricesoft.com has released critical feature enhancements to its comprehensive ezAccounting software , giving small business owners and accountants an immediate, reliable path to meet the upcoming third-quarter IRS Form 941 electronic filing deadline on Monday, November 2, 2026 . By removing the friction of paper-based mailing, ezAccounting allows organizations to process and transmit their quarterly tax documentation straight to federal servers from their desktop while seamlessly tying those records to daily operations like client invoicing and vendor orders. 
 Download and test ezAccounting today to experience automated, paperless 941 electronic filing before the November 2nd deadline. 
 "Small businesses need robust, self-contained financial tools that handle daily cash flow and seasonal tax deadlines simultaneously," said Dr. Ge, Founder of Halfpricesoft.com. "ezAccounting delivers full-scale operations—from tracking customer invoices to direct tax filing—in an intuitive interface backed by responsive customer support." 
 The 2026-2027 ezAccounting suite is currently available at a promotional bundle price 2026 + 2027 Bundle for $319 (regularly $418.00) 
 Evaluating the software now with our 30-day free trial allows teams to verify compatibility, begin secure data input, and establish a clean financial foundation well ahead of year-end reporting. Start today! 
 Get the details of the streamlined e941 add-on feature available with ezAccounting purchase. 
 All-in-One Local Financial Management 
 While ezAccounting streamlines your quarterly e-filing obligations, the platform is engineered to serve as a complete, independent business accounting ecosystem. It manages day-to-day business accounting without monthly subscription fees through several built-in modules: 
 Custom Invoicing & AR: Generate, print, or email professional customer invoices, track accounts receivable, and process incoming customer payments to maintain an accurate cash flow ledger. 
 Purchase Orders & AP: Streamline vendor management by creating official purchase orders, tracking inventory arrivals, and managing accounts payable to ensure bills are paid on time. 
 Offline Data Privacy: Unlike cloud-based SaaS accounting software, ezAccounting installs locally on your computer. Your financial data, profit margins, and employee information remain completely offline and protected. 
 Built-in Check Printing & Payroll: Design and print custom checks on blank check stock for both vendor payments and employee payroll, completely eliminating the ongoing expense of pre-printed checks. 
 Comprehensive Tax Compliance: Automatically updates to match shifting federal and state tax codes, ensuring error-free generation of Forms W-2, W-3, 940, 943, and 941. 
 Story Continues Eliminate the risk of late filing fines this quarter . Download the 30-day free trial of ezAccounting today with no credit card required, or lock in the 2026-2027 ezAccounting Bundle for just $319 (discounted from $418). 
 About Halfpricesoft 
 Halfpricesoft is a premier developer of straightforward, high-efficiency business software solutions, specializing in payroll systems, check printing utilities, and tax compliance automation. Serving over 20,000 small businesses and accounting practices nationwide since 2003, the company focuses on delivering robust, localized software architectures that eliminate high recurring enterprise costs.
